GmailFilter.description: Mail filter of a Gmail account.

action.description: Action applied to messages matching the criteria.

GmailFilterAction.description: Action applied by a Gmail filter to a matching message.

addLabelIds.description: Identifiers of labels to add to the message.

forward.description: Email address the message is forwarded to.

removeLabelIds.description: Identifiers of labels to remove from the message.

GmailFilterCriteria.description: Conditions matched by a Gmail filter against incoming messages.

excludeChats.description: Whether chat messages are excluded from matching.

from.description: Sender display name or email address to match.

hasAttachment.description: Whether the message must have an attachment.

negatedQuery.description: Gmail search query the message must not match.

query.description: Gmail search query the message must match.

size.description: Message size in bytes compared with `size_comparison`.

sizeComparison.description: How the message size relates to the `size` field.

subject.description: Case-insensitive phrase matched in the message subject.

to.description: Recipient display name or email address to match.

GmailFilterSizeComparison.description: Comparison applied to the message size in a filter criterion.

oneOf.description: Matches messages smaller than the given size.
Matches messages larger than the given size.

GmailFiltersListResponse.description: Response wrapping the filters of a Gmail account.
